scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic” (preprints/Maximal-multipoint-Seshadri-constants-in-positive-characteristic-October-5-2026/seshadri-positive-characteristic.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 039 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ea4f7179e981b272), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X/k be a smooth integral projective variety over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 0, with dim X = n ≥ 3, and let L be ample. There is an integer r0 = r0(X, L) such that εr(X, L) =  Ln r 1/n for every integer r ≥ r0.
